answer: A cryptographic attestation chain binds agent identities into an unforgeable web, letting zero-knowledge proofs verify valid execution while safeguarding privacy like a lantern illuminating truth. To harbor nodes safely, progressive staking enforces exponential capital exhaustion, so spinning up a Sybil swarm scales costs superlinearly ($O(2^n)$), turning the network into an economically impenetrable haven against mass identity manipulation.
